title: zombiE
description: a realistic zombie modpack about survival
body:
🧟‍♂️ zombiE is a hardcore Minecraft zombie survival modpack where the dead don’t just wander — they hunt. Every night becomes a brutal fight for survival as hordes grow stronger, smarter, and far more relentless. When the sun sets 🌑, the world transforms into a living nightmare where danger hides in every shadow and every sound could mean death.

The zombies are no longer slow, weak, or predictable. 👁️‍🗨️ They track your movements, surround your base, break through defenses, and overwhelm unprepared players with terrifying aggression. Surviving is no longer just about swinging a sword ⚔️ — it’s about planning ahead, managing resources, building secure shelters 🏚️, and staying one step ahead of the endless undead.

Explore a harsh and unforgiving world 🌍 where resources are scarce and every decision matters. Food 🍖, weapons 🔫, medical supplies 💉, and building materials become essential to your survival, forcing players to scavenge abandoned locations, raid dangerous structures, and risk everything for valuable loot. Exploration is dangerous but necessary, as stronger gear and rare supplies may be the only thing keeping you alive through the next night.

- ☣️ Features
- 🧟 Hardcore zombie survival gameplay with relentless undead hordes
- 🌑 Dynamic night system where danger increases after sunset
- 🧠 Smarter zombies that hunt, track, surround, and attack strategically
- 🏚️ Base-building and defense systems essential for survival
- 🔥 Intense atmosphere filled with tension, fear, and constant danger
- 🌍 Massive world exploration with abandoned locations and hidden loot
- ⚔️ Challenging combat requiring preparation and quick reactions
- 🍖 Scarce resources that make every item valuable
- 📦 Looting, scavenging, and survival-focused progression
- 🤝 Play solo or survive with friends in cooperative multiplayer
- 💀 Increasing difficulty that pushes players to adapt and evolve

Every night becomes a true survival challenge. Defend your shelter against massive hordes 🧱, reinforce your defenses, manage limited supplies, and prepare for increasingly dangerous encounters as the infection spreads across the world. The longer you survive, the deadlier the apocalypse becomes.

Whether you choose to hide in the shadows, build an unstoppable fortress 🛡️, or fight directly against endless waves of undead, zombiE delivers a tense and immersive survival experience where fear, strategy, and quick thinking are the keys to staying alive. One mistake can cost everything. ⚠️🩸

Will you survive the apocalypse… or become part of the horde? 🧟🔥
